map_role: Racing-wide dry industrial dual-altitude signal district and subterranean express exemplar
density_profile: Tower and workroom clusters separated by outdoor flight voids; one sparse excavated express band beneath continuous rooted earth

route_grammar.primary: West to east aerial beacon run, reverse back to west lift, east-west underground express excursion, rise to western finish
route_grammar.alternate: Enter west lift immediately, run east in subgrade tube, reverse at east lift, return west to finish
route_grammar.blocked_case: A real solid XYWH shutter covers the high suspension cue; the lower alternate remains 31x27 traversable

strong_motifs: west and east open-air access shafts
interesting_relationships: The upper traversable void overlays a separately traversable buried corridor
Outer shafts provide return/recovery without requiring airborne resets
Heavy masts root directly into the ground while equipment remains side-elevation
Sky signal obstacle leaves the subgrade alternative operational
authoring_affordances: Sparse buried rail bays with deliberate expansion sockets
Exposed tower galleries capable of later encounter and control instrumentation
Long empty ground-air transitions for manual race cue additions
Unscripted east arrestor and reversal space
Optional service rooms rather than mandatory course bottlenecks

setpiece_candidates.name: West shaft departure and recovery stage
Telemetry crown reveal and signal activation
Buried rail relief workshop expansion seam
East shaft emergency brake and turnaround

procedural_exemplar_value: Extract independent patterns for ground-rooted signal towers, vast above-ground flight clearance, excavated below-grade bypass tubes, inversion/reversal route networks, physically accessed shaft-to-tube connectors and optional event sockets.
similarity_avoidance: Unlike Aster Duplex Shipbreak's two exposed hulls, Rookfall's fractured bridge in a crater and Duskline's ceiling-hung diaphragm band, this layout contains independent grounded tower masts and a real traversable subterranean express corridor; its high/low inversion requires an explicit return rather than a shallow folded turn.
